local_review.review_comment: Reviewed the target-coordinate diff, local gate evidence, resolved statistics, and the fixes-native-image-run-fail rules. The removed scenario required a custom ClassLoader to define bytecode at runtime, which Native Image does not support; after traced metadata resolved the observable missing registration, the library caught the refusal and exposed only ClassNotFoundException, so it could not be verified with UnsupportedFeatureError. The remaining tests still exercise Pulsar reflection and default-implementation behavior and justify the shipped metadata. Overall and reflection dynamic-access coverage are both preserved at 5/5 (100%) from 4.2.1 to 5.0.0-M2. The exact Forge review finalization completed all three native lanes, metadata and style checks, and stats generation without changing the publishable tree.
